Coerce data to a square proximity matrix

Source: R/proximity.R
as_proximity.Rd

Accepts a square matrix, a data frame, or a dist object and returns a square numeric matrix with row and column labels. Rows are "from" objects and columns are "to" objects, as in asymmetric MDS.

Usage

as_proximity(x, type = c("dissimilarity", "similarity"), diag = NULL)

Arguments

x

A square matrix, data frame, or dist object.

type

Either "dissimilarity" or "similarity". Stored as an attribute; the values are not transformed.

diag

Value to put on the diagonal. NULL keeps the diagonal as is.

Value

A square numeric matrix with attribute type.

Examples

d <- as_proximity(eurodist)
attr(d, "type")
#> [1] "dissimilarity"
